items.headline: OpenAI Is Hiring Engineers to Build Travel Into ChatGPT
items.body: OpenAI is getting serious about travel: Francis Davidson, formerly of Sonder and acquisition target Odessia, is now the AI company's very first head of travel. And he’s already hunting for builders to design how trip requests work in ChatGPT.

items.headline: Airlines Brace for Up to $1 Billion Hit From Ground Stop, but Holiday Demand Holds Steady
items.body: Thanksgiving travelers have mostly shrugged off Friday’s ground stop. The four largest carriers haven’t been so lucky, facing up to $964 million in losses this quarter.

items.headline: Airbnb Updates House Rules After Host Pushback
items.body: Hosts got through to Airbnb on their complaints and Airbnb made changes. But most of the policies that stoked host anger, such as a limit on guest checkout chores, a ban on contracts, and collecting guest IDs, remain in place.

items.headline: Adani Turns Its Airports Into a Hotel Business

items.headline: In Jordan, Arab Travelers Fill Amman While Petra Waits for the West
items.body: Jordan’s tourism income is growing only because Arab and Asian visitors are replacing Western ones, and they are heading for Amman, not Petra. Until Western governments lift their travel warnings, the sites Jordan built its tourism on will keep struggling.
